description:
Extended Range: The large-capacity 374 Wh lithium-ion battery provides a maximum range of up to 50 miles on a single charge. This adult electric bike is perfect for long commutes and adventure rides
Well Design: Navigate various terrains with 26" knobby tires and front suspension fork. This ebike for adults handles both city commutes and off-road trails with ease
5 Working Modes: Electric bikes for men and women offer electric mode, pedal-assist mode, cruise mode, manual mode and walk mode, five riding modes for you to choose
Multi-Scenario Use: Designed to excel in both urban and off-road settings, versatile for commuting or mountain riding. An ideal choice for those seeking versatility in their daily rides

Easy Setup, Unmatched Support: 85% pre-assembled electric bike with all tools and detailed instructions for a hassle-free assembly. Any question please feel free to contact our dedicated support team
